name: albania-tax-optimization
description: Use this skill whenever asked about reducing tax in Albania, tax planning, or legal strategies to minimise tax for a self-employed person or small business in Albania, for tax year 2026. Trigger on phrases like 'reduce tax Albania', '0% tax small business Albania', 'simplified profit tax', 'freelancer Albania', 'self-employed vs company Albania', 'save tax Albania', 'tax planning Albania'. This skill covers the 0% rate for traders, the self-employed and entities with gross income up to ALL 14m (to 2029, Law 29/2023 art. 69(1)(dh)), the repeal of the old simplified profit tax, the freelancer single-client reclassification rule, the standard rates above the threshold, the 2026 social and health contribution floor that still applies at 0%, and the anti-avoidance red lines. Out of scope: full income tax computation (albania-income-tax), companies (al-corporate-tax), VAT (albania-vat), contributions in detail (albania-social-contributions). ALWAYS read this skill before advising on any Alba
